comment: The step length is 15 divided by the tempo in seconds (micromacro.cpp:234), which is a sixteenth note. The base frequency is the A4 tune knob times two to the power of the base note over twelve, counted in semitones from A (micromacro.cpp:240, :241). A pitch knob raises that by its own number of steps of 2^(1/12), 2^(1/24) or 2^(1/72) (micromacro.cpp:22 to :24, :253 to :270). The pitch output is minus the base-two logarithm of 440 over the frequency, clamped to ±4 (micromacro.cpp:277), so 0V is A4 rather than the C4 that Rack's own oscillators use. The gate outputs are set to 0V every sample while playing and to 5V only on the sample the step changes (micromacro.cpp:278, :296), which is where the one-sample pulse comes from.
